candidates.source_name: KosovaJob.com — Kosovo's largest job board (bank/IT/procurement vacancies)
candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo banks (ProCredit, Raiffeisen, TEB, NLB, BKT, Banka Ekonomike, BPB, Credins) post IT, project-manager, procurement and vendor-management vacancies here. Role titles such as 'menaxher projekti', 'zyrtar i prokurimit', 'core banking' or 'kartela/pagesa' reveal in-flight programmes months before any award notice.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled keyword crawl of listing pages/search endpoint (sq keywords: bankë, prokurim, menaxher projekti, IT, kartela, pagesa), dedupe by advert ID, archive full advert text before expiry (postings are removed after deadline).
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq-language web search for bank project-manager vacancies
queries_used: punë bankë Kosovë menaxher projekti sistemi bankar vende të lira pune

candidates.source_name: DuaPune.com — Kosovo job portal, project-manager category
candidates.why_relevant: Second major Albanian-language vacancy aggregator for Kosovo, with a dedicated 'Menaxher Projektesh' subcategory. Aggregates postings from banks, PSPs and their local IT integrators, i.e. both buyer-side and vendor-side capacity build-up signals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl category and search URLs on a daily cadence; snapshot advert bodies; extract employer entity to build an actor map of banks/vendors that are staffing up.
queries_used: punë bankë Kosovë menaxher projekti sistemi bankar vende të lira pune

candidates.source_name: PunaIme.org — Kosovo vacancy portal (banking roles)
candidates.why_relevant: Carries banking-sector adverts ('Mbikëqyrës bankar', 'Projekt Menaxher') including from smaller banks and microfinance/PSP actors that do not always publish on their own websites.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of /konkursi/ listings filtered on financial-sector employers and IT/procurement keywords.
queries_used: punë bankë Kosovë menaxher projekti sistemi bankar vende të lira pune

candidates.source_name: PortalPune.com — Kosovo vacancy aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Additional Albanian-language aggregator carrying project-manager and IT roles; useful for redundancy because Kosovo adverts are frequently syndicated across portals with different retention windows.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly keyword crawl; use mainly as a backfill/dedupe source against KosovaJob and DuaPune.
queries_used: punë bankë Kosovë menaxher projekti sistemi bankar vende të lira pune

candidates.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — careers / vacancies page
candidates.why_relevant: Primary-source hiring channel of one of Kosovo's largest banks, including IT & Communications department roles. Group-driven programme staffing (digital channels, card systems, payments migration) surfaces here first and is a leading indicator of vendor selection.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly diff of the vacancies list (sq/en variants of the page); archive job descriptions naming systems/vendors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en-language web search for Kosovo bank vacancies
queries_used: Kosovo bank job vacancy procurement officer vendor management IT

candidates.source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — career section (sq/en/sr)
candidates.why_relevant: Bank careers channel published in three languages including Serbian ('Rad u ProCredit Banci'), which makes it one of the few sr-language hiring signals inside Kosovo. Onboarding-programme intakes correlate with operational/IT expansion.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor /eng/, /srb/ and Albanian career paths; diff monthly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: multilingual web search (sq/en) on bank career pages
queries_used: "karriera" OR "career" ProCredit TEB NLB BKT Banka Ekonomike Kosovë vende pune IT

candidates.source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — LinkedIn company page
candidates.why_relevant: Company posts announce system go-lives, digital-channel launches, partner/vendor collaborations and open roles — the classic 'programme in flight' leak. Employee title changes (e.g. 'Core Banking Project Manager') are equally diagnostic.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape (ToS). Use manual analyst review or a licensed data provider / LinkedIn Talent-Insights style product; alternatively capture the same announcements where mirrored on the bank site or local media.
queries_used: "karriera" OR "career" ProCredit TEB NLB BKT Banka Ekonomike Kosovë vende pune IT
candidates.observed_blocker: LinkedIn requires login for full company feed and prohibits automated scraping in its terms of service

candidates.source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) — LinkedIn page
candidates.why_relevant: Sector body representing nine commercial banks; announces conferences, working groups and joint sector initiatives (e.g. instant payments, financial-literacy, AML) that precede coordinated procurement across member banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual analyst monitoring; cross-check every item against the association's own website/Facebook where posts are usually mirrored.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from association name found in sq search
queries_used: "bankassoc-kos" OR "Kosovo Banking Association" website Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës

candidates.source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK) — news & conferences

Agendas and speaker lists identify which infrastructure topics — instant payments, CBDC, crypto regulation — are entering the national roadmap, and which vendors and IFIs are circling.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the news/press listing (id=104 style listing and modern WP paths) in sq and en; capture conference programmes and PDF agendas; extract speaker affiliations as vendor/actor seeds.

candidates.source_name: Balkan Payment Forum (promoney-events)

Sponsor and speaker rosters are a direct read on which payment vendors are courting Kosovo banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch agenda/speakers/sponsors pages before and after each edition; archive PDF programmes; map speaker employers to the Kosovo actor list.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en-language search for regional payments events

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo-hosted fintech/payments conference with a published agenda and sponsor list was found for Pristina in 2026; the only clearly Kosovo-relevant payments event surfaced is the regional Balkan Payment Forum (organiser based outside Kosovo) plus BQK-hosted regulator conferences.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq and en returned generic global fintech-event calendars (Money20/20, eventbrowse, tapix, vendelux) rather than a Kosovo-specific payments expo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's event-signal channel for Kosovo depends mainly on regulator-hosted conferences and regional events; there is no local trade expo whose exhibitor list can be harvested annually.

negative_findings.description: No specific LinkedIn or press announcement of a Kosovo bank or PSP naming a core-banking/payments implementation partner was located through open web search in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned generic vendor marketing (Skaleet, PSP Lab, sdk.finance) and one relevant institutional item (IFC/SECO partnership with BQK on digital financial services).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-announcement signals for Kosovo appear to live behind LinkedIn's login wall rather than on the open web, so this channel likely needs licensed access or manual analyst review.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language hiring/event signals specific to Kosovo banks are very thin: sr searches surfaced only generic Serbian job boards filtered to Kosovska Mitrovica, with no bank-specific 'konkurs' for a Kosovo-licensed bank found.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr query 'konkurs za posao banka Kosovo Mitrovica' returned board homepages, not bank adverts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr is a mandated language for this run; the coverage exists only as a thin, low-yield channel and should not be assumed equivalent to the sq channel.

negative_findings.description: None of the URLs in this slice were fetched for liveness during this pass; all are recorded from search-result metadata and search-snippet content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery-only pass; no fetch verdicts issued.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must confirm reachability; absence of a fetch here is not evidence a source is dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Only three of the nine KBA member banks (Raiffeisen, ProCredit, BPB) have an identified careers/news endpoint; TEB, NLB Prishtina, BKT, Banka Ekonomike, Credins, IsBank and Ziraat are not yet mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically resolve the sq careers ('Karriera' / 'Vende të lira pune') and news paths for each remaining KBA member bank and register each as its own source.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank PSPs, e-money and payment institutions licensed by BQK (and card processors/switch operators serving Kosovo) were not enumerated in this pass; only Paysera Kosova appeared incidentally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the BQK register of licensed payment/e-money institutions and build careers/LinkedIn/event monitors for each entity.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — the single richest indirect channel for this cell (company announcements, role titles, employee moves) — is ToS/login restricted and cannot be scraped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide between licensed data access and a manual analyst watchlist of ~25 Kosovo bank/PSP/integrator company pages plus key role titles; do not build a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo job adverts are removed shortly after the application deadline, so hiring signals are lost unless captured within days.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run daily crawls with full-text snapshotting on kosovajob.com, duapune.com, punaime.org and portalpune.com rather than periodic sampling.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor/sponsor rosters of regional events that Kosovo banks attend (Balkan Payment Forum, KosICT, Balkan Fintech Association activities, ICT chamber events) are only partially mapped, and past-edition agendas were not retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Archive agenda/speaker/sponsor pages for the last three editions of each event and build a recurring pre-event capture job.

brief: Kosovo's indirect procurement-signal landscape rests on three legs: a dense Albanian-language job-board layer (kosovajob.com, duapune.com, punaime.org, portalpune.com) plus individual bank careers pages, where IT/project-manager/procurement titles leak programmes months ahead of any notice; an event layer dominated by BQK-hosted regulator conferences and the regional Balkan Payment Forum, with STIKK/KosICT covering the local integrator community; and a sector-body layer (Kosovo Banking Association, bankassoc-kos.com) that doubles as the authoritative actor map of the nine commercial banks. The highest-value channel — LinkedIn company announcements and role changes — is login/ToS restricted and needs licensed or manual access rather than scraping. Serbian-language coverage is genuinely thin, limited to Serbia-based boards filtered to Kosovska Mitrovica, and no Kosovo-hosted fintech expo with a harvestable exhibitor list was found. Nothing in this slice was fetch-verified; treat all URLs as discovery-grade pending the deterministic liveness pass.
